review_request.summary: Requires `gcw:executor-hosted` before any hosted Action runs (including PR synchronize auto-triggers). Extends `prepare_gcw_hosted_step.py` with idempotent skip, `run_mode`, and `validate_command` outputs; updates `gcw-pr-review.yml` for verify-only re-runs. Fixes historical progress comment render leak via `max_seq` event lookup. Adds executor labels, tests, and hosted-agent documentation.
review_request.title: feat(gcw): gate hosted steps on executor labels and idempotent prepare

payload.reviewer_notes: Confirm PR synchronize on `gcw/issue-*` does not run pr-review when issue has `gcw:executor-local`. Verify pr-publish body hash validation still passes after a later pr-review event exists.
payload.risks: Executor label must be set before switching an in-flight issue to hosted; existing issues without `gcw:executor-hosted` will no longer auto-trigger Actions on push.
payload.scope: Hosted trigger gate, prepare idempotency, pr-review workflow branching, render fix, labels, skills, and docs. GitLab CI equivalents out of scope.
